class GeneralizedCoheytingAlgebra (α : Type*) extends Lattice α, OrderBot α, SDiff α where
  /-- `(· \ a)` is left adjoint to `(· ⊔ a)` -/
  sdiff_le_iff (a b c : α) : a \ b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ b ⊔ c
